The Office of International Linkages for Research and Development (ILRAD) was created in the latter part of year 2012. This is to address the growing needs of Mapúa University for international visibility for research and development (R&D), to be at par with its international counterparts, and to be globally known for its R&D capability. The primary objective of ILRAD is to create opportunities and establish platforms, venues, and avenues for research together with international research partners and/or collaborators. This will then lead to the creation of new knowledge that would be utilized for the development of new service, process, device, instrument, and product with economic value that could be used for improvement of society. This platform encourages more researchers and funders to come together and innovate. It is expected that ILRAD could pull more international experts and resources to become part and participate in Mapúa’s R&D group.

What type of visa I need to visit Mapua University?

Please follow through this link https://evisa.gov.ph/page/policy

What visa I need to visit foreign institution?

               a) Visit to Southeast Asian Countries and Taiwan not exceeding 14 days does not require a visa.

               b) Visit to other countries please send mail to ilrad@mapua.edu.ph 

What documents do I need to prepare for visa application as outbound student?

a)   Invitation letter
b)   Birth Certificate issued by PSA 
c)    Bark Certificate showing six (6) months record;
d)    Passport showing validity of at least six (6) beyond the intended stay at the foreign institution; 
e)    Notarized affidavit of support in case bank certificate is not under the name of student applicant;
f)    Active Certificate of Matriculation;
g)   Original Certificate of Grades with dry seal; 
h)    Endorsement to the Embassy from the Office of the President;
I)    2 pcs current photos (passport size or 2 x 2 with white background, or as required by the country of destination taken       within 3 months); 
j)    Other additional requirements, please send email to ilrad@mapua.edu.ph or mcbironia@mapua.edu.ph
